structs.notes: Size 6192 is proven by method 1 (mov ecx, 1830h -> allocator -> ctor stores the vtable). The current IDA layout is already right from 8 to 1808 except the 328..352 pad and the tail: the 792..1808 block matches the ctor, the accessors and the cleanup offsets exactly. Game-test is 16 bytes larger from 352 onward (its 368 is the IDA 352), and the tail is only consistent with the -16 shift. The layout the builder wrote (6192) matches Replay. The total-size change from 6208 to 6192 is a PROPOSAL for the coordinator (rule 3). The Replay vptr at 0 is the derived vtable; the base is bdLobbyServiceBase with only the vptr. Nothing was written to IDA.
